title: Calibration Count Reuse: Validity Does Not Determine Efficiency
abstract: arXiv:2609.25138v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Calibration count reuse raises separate validity and efficiency questions. We give a validity criterion for general count-dependent nonconformity scores: transferring one count from another class to the scored class must not improve its conformity. A leave-self-out full conformal reference proves the criterion without requiring normalization or preservation of same-class score order. For a common separable transformation, universal exchangeable validity is equivalent to being nondecreasing in the count, provided $K\alpha \geq 1$; normalized multiplicative weights obey the complementary nonincreasing condition. Additive penalties are covered under the stated information restrictions. Efficiency has no parallel ordering: two iid constructions make the same valid rule improve or worsen expected size at unchanged coverage. An expanded 55-rule study finds no resolved advantage from selected live-count rules over uniform weights. Image studi

translated_title: 校准计数复用：有效性并不决定效率
translated_abstract: 校准计数复用引发了有效性与效率两个相互独立的问题。我们针对一般的依赖计数的非一致性得分给出了一个有效性准则：将一个计数从另一个类别转移到被评分的类别时，不得改善其一致性。一个留自身在外的完全共形参考证明了该准则，且无需归一化或保持同类得分顺序。对于一种常见的可分离变换，在 $K\alpha \geq 1$ 的条件下，普遍可交换有效性等价于得分对计数非递减；而归一化乘法权重则满足互补的非递增条件。在所述信息限制下，加性惩罚也被该准则涵盖。效率方面则不存在类似的排序：两个独立同分布的构造使得同一个有效规则在覆盖率不变的情况下，既能改善也能恶化期望预测集大小。一项扩展至55条规则的研究发现，所选的实时计数规则相对于均匀权重并无确定的优势。
tldr: 该论文为依赖计数的非一致性得分建立了有效性准则，并证明有效性并不决定效率——同一有效规则在覆盖率不变时可能改善或恶化期望预测集大小，且55条规则的实验未发现实时计数规则相对均匀权重有确定优势。
en_tdlr: The paper establishes a validity criterion for count-dependent nonconformity scores and shows that validity does not determine efficiency—the same valid rule can improve or worsen expected prediction set size at unchanged coverage, with a 55-rule study finding no resolved advantage of live-count rules over uniform weights.
